recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, atmospheric composition featuring three male portraits emerging from deep shadow, arranged in a triangular formation. A central vertical axis is defined by a converging rainbow of light rays at the bottom and a glowing, chrome-textured triangular emblem at the top that emits electric blue light.
coreVisualRelationships: The central portrait acts as the apex of a human triangle, mirrored by the geometric triangle above.
The rainbow rays converge at the base of the central portrait, creating a sense of upward energy.
The electric blue glow of the top emblem contrasts with the warm, naturalistic lighting on the faces.
coreInvariants: Deep black background with heavy grain/texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three heads positioned in the center-middle, forming a triangle; the top head is slightly smaller to suggest depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing chrome emblem at the top center, which serves as the primary light source for the upper half.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the rainbow rays upward to the central face, then continues to the glowing emblem, finally scanning the horizontal text at the very top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the subjects, creating a void-like environment.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Spectral rainbow (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, violet rays)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value/saturation in the light effects against zero value in the background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright daylight; all colors must appear as light sources in a dark room.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extended sans-serif and heavy decorative chrome
letterConstructionRules: Top display text is a wide, geometric sans-serif with high tracking.
Main logo uses a forced perspective arc, chrome beveling, and lightning bolt terminals on the first and last letters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'T' and 'H' in the central logo extend downward into sharp, jagged lightning bolt points.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A wide, quiet geometric sans-serif at the top balances the aggressive, illustrative chrome logo below.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical feel of the top metadata text.
The main logo requires custom vector work for the lightning bolts and chrome beveling.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A dark void with three male portraits in a triangular layout. Faces are lit with soft rim lighting. From the bottom center, six thin, glowing rainbow rays (red to violet) emerge and converge toward the central face. At the top center, a bright electric blue triangular glow radiates outward.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a chrome-textured, arched logo in the center of the blue glow with lightning bolt extensions. Add a single line of widely-spaced, extended sans-serif text at the very top edge.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure black with film grain?
Do the rainbow rays converge at a single point?
Is the top logo beveled with a metallic chrome finish?
Is the top text line extremely wide-tracked?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the top text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the band members

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of light effects and photography

postGenerationChecks: Check for triangular symmetry in the composition.
Ensure the chrome logo has a distinct blue outer glow.
Verify the rainbow rays have a soft, blurred light-trail quality.
Confirm the top text is perfectly centered and horizontal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Triangular portrait arrangement + converging spectral rays + glowing chrome header + deep black void = 80s Progressive Rock Aesthetic.
